---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Activity), Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean, name = "attacks") |>
  group_by(Activity) |>
  filter(sum(attacks) >= 50) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Activity = fct_reorder(Activity, attacks, .fun = sum)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Activity, y = attacks, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Activity", y = "Shark attacks", fill = "Outcome")
```
